learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how dance is for everyone and how it can break old rules to show true freedom, equality, and self-confidence!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Sometimes people think certain dances are only for boys or only for girls, or only for certain ages. Breaking barriers means ignoring those silly rules because dance belongs to absolutely everyone!
You do not always have to follow traditional steps. You can invent your own unique dance style that expresses exactly who you are and what you feel inside.
Stepping onto a dance floor or stage might feel scary at first. But once you start moving to the beat, dance builds massive self-confidence and makes you feel brave and powerful.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Signature Move
fun_activity.instructions: Invent a brand new, 3-step dance move that no one has ever seen before. Give your signature move a cool name and teach it to a friend or family member to spread the fun!

quick_recap: ⭐ Dance is a universal language that does not care about age, gender, or background.
⭐ We can break stereotypes by dancing freely and supporting everyone who loves to move.
⭐ Creating your own personal dance style is a great way to express your true self.
⭐ Practicing and performing dance is an amazing way to build your inner confidence.
